description_en: Modifies the weight of a destination route entry for an IPsec-VPN connection
description_zh: 调用ModifyVcoRouteEntryWeight接口修改IPsec连接下目的路由条目的权重值
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-vco-route-entry-weight --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --route-dest 192.168.10.0/24 --weight 100 --new-weight 0 --next-hop vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVcoRouteEntryWeight

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the destination route entry to be modified
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的目的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: route_dest

parameters.help_en:
The current weight of the destination route entry to be modified. Valid values:

0: low priority.
100: high priority
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的目的路由条目的权重值。取值：

0：表示低优先级。
100：表示高优先级
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The new weight of the destination route entry. Valid values:

0: low priority.
100: high priority
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的目的路由条目新的权重值。取值：

0：表示低优先级。
100：表示高优先级
parameters.name: new_weight

parameters.help_en: The next hop of the destination route entry to be modified
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的目的路由条目的下一跳
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to Ipsec (default), which specifies the IPsec tunneling protocol
parameters.help_zh: 隧道协议。仅取值：Ipsec（默认值），表示IPsec隧道协议
parameters.name: overlay_mode

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
